title: Dentacor — §58-69-5 Enforcement Forborne
content: The Dentacor Agreement states that the Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL) will forgo enforcement action under Utah Code §58-69-5 during the demonstration period so long as Participant abides by the Agreement. This applies only to authorized conduct and does not preclude enforcement for other unlawful or unprofessional conduct. The recorded initial mitigation period ended May 31, 2026; the retained original does not establish whether a later extension or termination decision exists.
